name: Marg Speaks
summary: Near Theramore, Marg's stolen pendant and unfinished duty still weigh on them. Marg asks you to find the muckshell that killed them, recover the jeweled pendant taken from Alliance soldiers, and carry it to Nazeer Bloodpike in Brackenwall Village.

sections.title: What Marg Saw Near Theramore
sections.body: Alliance soldiers had made camp on the beach near Theramore. One wore a pendant set with more gems than a soldier could pay for. Marg slipped into the camp that night and stole it. On the way back to base, a muckshell crab-man killed Marg. Now Marg asks you to find the muckshell, recover the pendant, and bring it to Nazeer in Brackenwall Village.

sections.title: What Nazeer Makes of It
sections.body: Nazeer is startled that a Stormwind soldier wore the pendant. You have learned how Marg died, yet the pendant raises a new question. Nazeer warns that it may bring dire effects to both the Alliance and the Horde.

faq.q: Who is Marg and how did Marg die?
faq.answer: Marg stole a jeweled pendant from Alliance soldiers camped near Theramore. A muckshell crab-man killed Marg on the way back to base.

faq.q: Where did the jeweled pendant come from?
aliases: where did the pendant come from
faq.answer: An Alliance soldier wore the pendant at a beach camp near Theramore. It held more gems than a soldier could pay for, and Marg stole it that night.

aliases: where do i take the pendant
faq.answer: Nazeer Bloodpike receives the recovered pendant in Brackenwall Village.
